critic.verdict: The film is a clear, purposeful triumph move: from a wide street view it rises and pushes in toward Schooling on the open top deck, ending on a strong held frame with the raised medal prominent. The bus and figure stay coherent together with no tearing, ghosting, doubled edges or awkward frame clipping, the first frame reads as a complete celebration scene, and the final frame is a good dwell image. The light-sweep suits the sunny contemporary cut-paper style without overwhelming it.
